{
  "dataset_name": "bitcoinheist_ransomware",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "log_income",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed income to compress extreme tail and produce a smooth linear-friendly scale.",
      "formula": "np.log1p(income)",
      "value_range": [16.0, 35.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linearizes heavy-tailed income for stable SVM margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "log_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed transaction count to reduce skew.",
      "formula": "np.log1p(count)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooths transaction-count distribution for linear separability.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "log_neighbors",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed neighbor count.",
      "formula": "np.log1p(neighbors)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 7.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses degree skew for linear weighting.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "log_weight",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Symmetric log transform of weight handling extremely small values.",
      "formula": "np.log1p(np.maximum(weight, 0.0))",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Tames extreme weight tail for stable linear coefficients.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "looped_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Fraction of looped transactions relative to total count, an interpretable circularity score.",
      "formula": "looped / (count + 1.0)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Bounded ratio is directly useful as a linear feature for behavioral signal.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "income_per_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log of average income per transaction count, a per-event severity measure.",
      "formula": "np.log1p(income / (count + 1.0))",
      "value_range": [15.0, 35.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Per-transaction income magnitude useful as linear severity feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "neighbors_per_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Neighbor density per transaction, log-scaled.",
      "formula": "np.log1p(neighbors / (count + 1.0))",
      "value_range": [0.0, 7.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures fan-out density used by SVM as smooth predictor.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "day_of_year_sin",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sine-like cyclic encoding approximation of day-of-year via polynomial smoothing.",
      "formula": "np.sin(2 * 3.141592653589793 * day / 365.0)",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Cyclic temporal projection helps linear separability across seasons.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "day_of_year_cos",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Cosine-like cyclic encoding approximation of day-of-year.",
      "formula": "np.cos(2 * 3.141592653589793 * day / 365.0)",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Complements sine encoding for full cyclic representation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "length_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Length normalized to [0,1] using observed maximum (144).",
      "formula": "np.clip(length / 144.0, 0.0, 1.0)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Bounded chain-length signal directly usable as linear coefficient.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "activity_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted composite of normalized activity signals (count, neighbors, looped) emphasizing overall transaction intensity.",
      "formula": "(np.log1p(count) / 10.0) + (np.log1p(neighbors) / 7.0) + (np.log1p(looped) / 10.0)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear composite aligns with SVM hyperplane orientation for activity-driven signals.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "suspicious_pattern_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic judgment of suspicious transaction structure: high looped ratio combined with low neighbors and high income-per-count indicates self-cycling laundering-like behavior. Computed as a bounded smooth score combining these signals.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_judgment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes domain heuristic about circular flow patterns as a smooth linear feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
